companyDescription: AI cloud / neocloud · GPU infrastructure for hyperscalers and AI labs · $104B revenue backlog, FY26 revenue guide $12.4-13.2B · ~$50B debt load under bond-market stress
priceNote: Live $53.64 (-1.1%) on Oct 26, 2026 — 52-week range $51.24-$141.79, -53% YoY. Market cap ~$29.6B. Fell 25% in the week to Oct 16 on bond distress (2031 bond yield >16% intraday, CDS >1,000bp).
summary: CoreWeave reports Q3 around Nov 10 (aggregator date, not yet company-confirmed), with the equity trading like a credit instrument after an October bond selloff. The bull case is concrete: a $104B backlog, Q2 revenue +112%, adj. operating income ~2x guide (stock +15.5% on that print), and an FY26 guide raised to $12.4-13.2B. The bear case is equally concrete: ~$50B of debt and $860-940M of Q3 interest. Consensus $134.50 (+151%; clears the gate). earnings_beat has no tier-2 penalty. Written against the core Base optimism bias of +23.7pp (realized 14d P75 +6.6%, P90 +11.7%). Base +25% assumes a 1-3 month horizon in which Q3 shows operating leverage outrunning interest and the bonds stabilize. This pick's catalyst is ~15 days out, just outside the 14d North Star window. แนะนำ 2-3% ของ portfolio — Speculative.

catalysts.name: Q3 2026 earnings
catalysts.description: Expected ~Nov 10 after the close (aggregator date; CoreWeave typically confirms ~2 weeks ahead). Q3 interest expense is guided $860-940M. The read is adj. operating income vs. the FY26 $960M-1.15B guide, backlog ($104.2B at Q2), and financing commentary after the bond selloff.

risks: Credit stress: 2031 bond yields briefly >16% and CDS >1,000bp — the equity is subordinated to a stressed capital structure.
Q3 interest expense of $860-940M against a modest operating profit; any slip in operating leverage widens losses fast.
Neocloud sector narrative risk (Gartner: 80% of neoclouds gone by 2030; public skepticism from prominent tech figures).
Customer concentration in a handful of hyperscalers/AI labs; contract renegotiation risk if AI capex cools.
Earnings date is an aggregator estimate (~Nov 10), not yet company-confirmed.

estimateDates.note: Interest cost vs operating leverage; financing

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed funds at 3.75-4.00% after the surprise Sep 16, 2026 hike (first since 2023). The Oct 27-28 FOMC is priced ~93% hold / ~7% +25bp as of Oct 25 — but hike odds briefly spiked to ~44% after the hot Sep CPI print on Oct 14, so the path stays two-sided.
macroRisk.inflationNote: September CPI +0.6% m/m, 3.7% y/y headline; core +0.3% m/m, 2.6% y/y — both above consensus. Headline re-acceleration keeps a further 2026 hike live.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: ~$50B of debt with Q3 interest guided at $860-940M — the stock is now a credit trade. Every bp on yields hits both its cost of capital and the equity multiple.
macroRisk.summary: HIGH — the Oct 28 FOMC is priced ~93% hold, but September CPI ran hot (3.7% headline) and a further 2026 hike is still live. October's growth/AI-infra selloff was largely a rates trade, so the decision and the dot path matter directly for this name's multiple.

entryStrategy.verdict: SPECULATIVE — a real AI-infra franchise priced as a credit event, into a ~Nov 10 print. The measured core median at-catalyst return is -6.9% with 74% of picks underwater at their event (n=54), so Entry 2 ($47-51) is preferred and Entry 1 is a starter only. Small size: the downside is a capital-structure problem, not just a bad quarter.
